invariants.description: Every violation MUST carry a deterministic violation_id
Violation ledger MUST be append-only; every entry carries prev_digest
Sealed ViolationRecords MUST NOT be modified after writing
CRITICAL violations MUST set human0_required=True and emit HUMAN0_REQUIRED
Severity MUST be one of [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW]; reject unknowns
Context dict MUST be size-bounded (<=2 KB serialised JSON)
violation_id derivation MUST be deterministic given same inputs
All report() and waive() calls MUST be sealed in the ledger
Any internal CIVR error MUST fail closed (raise, never swallow)
